scope: Selected RTX 3090 Ti schedules vs precision-matched preceding schedules, pre-repair released computation and actual default SDPA, B1/H16 contiguous BHSD, FP16/BF16 dense/causal. CUDA-event latency across warmed per-call graph replays includes any replay/launch scheduling floor; forward retains autograd and joint includes all three gradients. CPU input preparation, compilation and full-model costs are excluded.

protocol.reference: Full-length centered FP64 on identical rounded inputs, two-head chunks.
protocol.accuracy_gate: Each output/dQ/dK/dV norm-relative error below 1% BF16 or 0.5% FP16; exact zero when reference norm is zero. Every element also passes atol=rtol=0.02 BF16 or 0.003 FP16. Inaccurate previous/SDPA calls remain diagnostic, not qualified speed comparisons.
protocol.kernel_verification: CUDA driver graph-node symbols and resources only; eager activity verification belongs to a separate process.
protocol.phase_note: Backward retains a forward graph. Separately timed medians need not sum to joint.

control_scopes.released: Current compiler with the computation and schedules of main 3e17149: disable the Ti selector and central precision repairs. Other device selectors cannot match this full SM86 Ti. This is not a byte-identical old cubin; failed numerical gates are diagnostic.
control_scopes.previous: Retain all shared precision repairs and disable only the Ti schedule selector.
control_scopes.cute: Final Ti schedule and shared precision repairs.
control_scopes.sdpa: Actual default native SDPA on identical rounded inputs and the same runtime stack.

sustained_telemetry.scope: Separate sustained BF16 B1/H16/S4096 forward plus all gradients; four alternating 20-second passes (previous, selected, selected, previous), first 5 seconds of event groups and first 25 telemetry samples excluded from summaries; event groups target 200 ms, capped at 100 replays; 200 ms whole-board telemetry; no profiler. D256 dense. Whole-board clock/power samples do not normalize individual kernel cycles.

earlier_d256.scope: Separate node-level Nsight Systems activity verification. Eager operands/transfers and warmup prepared before capture; no benchmark evaluate() setup clones in traced ranges. Instrumented kernel durations are diagnostic and are not canonical medians.

final_d64.scope: Separate final-source node-level Systems verification, prepared eager operands outside tracing; exact full symbols/counts matched against driver graph metadata. Instrumented durations are diagnostics, not canonical timing. Both eager and replayed graph outputs pass independent FP64 gates.

earlier_d256.scope: CUPTI resource-loaded ELF matched by complete graph symbol, driver target/function resources and unique image hash. CuTe compiler export equals the loaded cubin; its separate PTX text is ISA9.4,targetsm86. No packaged PTX recovered from the selected ELF images.

final_d64.scope: Exact final-source symbols/resources and unique CUPTI loaded ELFs; actual compiler backward cubin equals the selected N2 loaded image for both modes. Packaged native PTX is absent; CuTe compiler PTX is separately retained. All actual bytes and associations remain in the checked evidence supplement.

q32_pipeline.decision: All Q32 one-stage, two-stage full-V-reload and two-stage upper-V-retention variants rejected; accepted Q64 kept.

d64_fixed_owner.decision: Promote BF16 only for qualified square 1024 through 4096; FP16 retains repaired N1 because the long causal control regressed.
